seed_derivation: ChaCha20Rng::from_seed(sha256(seed.to_le_bytes() || 0 || source || 0 || key)); sample order sha256((seed+1).to_le_bytes() || 0 || source || 0 || key)

prose.basis: rajpurkar/squad_v2's registered licence (qd_data.sources); share-alike, carried per row

scrambled.basis: per row: the corpus row's pool_id -> commitpackft pool -> bigcode/commitpackft download (commit, new_file), as the main defect corpus is joined

unseen-language.basis: authored in this repository (crates/qd-mutate/src/noul_rows/templates.rs) and released under its LICENSE, Apache-2.0 -- the workspace licence in Cargo.toml

preregistered.decision: Fable I-2 (2026-10-01): noul at 10% of defect rows instead of 5%, keeping the F2 forms, so noul is a shared feature that survives weight averaging

defect_class_in_distribution_abstention.bound: <= 2% on every seed (and on the average)
defect_class_in_distribution_abstention.kind: F3: Fable's data-design bound and the cost check on I-2, not a gate

preregistered.gates_unchanged: ood_abstain (Wilson lower >= 0.90 OOD, Wilson upper <= 0.05 in-distribution) is read-only (rule 2)

ood_abstain_by_category.carried_from: F2 (campaign/v31-noul-preregistered.json): >= 30/60 on every seed, each of prose, scrambled, unseen-language
ood_abstain_by_category.note: no bar for the averaged model is set here; that is Fable's to set

preregistered.recorded: 2026-10-01, before defect-noul-v3 was generated and before any v4 run
preregistered.risk: a noul set designed to span the suite's three forms passes the suite's forms; whether those three categories are the product's OOD definition is a suite question for the human (rule 2)
preregistered.share: per_source 1668 (2 x 834), 5,004 rows = 10.02% of corpus v3's 49,953 defect rows; F2 forms in exact halves; unseen-language as built

supply.lines_and_tokens: 1,668 distinct repos, one row each; the generator also filled 2,010 per source, so this is not at the supply limit
supply.paragraph: 834 of 1,005 selectable at 3 per title (13,416 eligible paragraphs over 335 train titles); 227 of 320 titles used at the cap
supply.question: 834 of 1,005 rows at 3 per title (335 titles)
supply.template: 1,668 instantiations of the same 35 train templates (39-70 rows per template; v2 had 19-35). The doubled count is reached by repeating sources; the honest alternative is a second, versioned template catalogue (new unseen languages and templates, a new allowlist step), which this generator does not have yet

preregistered.why: J7g (row 1d93b3ee): the masters average of J4's three seeds scored choice 83.2% (seeds 76.5-78.2%) but OOD abstention 0/180 (seeds 46/33/66 of 180). Fable's inferred reading: noul learned from 2,502 rows in one pass points a different way per seed and cancels under averaging
